_note: Synthetic billing fixture for Contoso Dental (invented): a managed-services contract scope, tickets and time entries. Written for B-76; not a capture from a real PSA or contract. Tickets T-3101 and T-3102 also exist in fixtures/psa/contoso-dental.json (titles must match); the rest exist only here. Fixture-based.

clauses.text: Provider internal work (training, quoting) is never billed.
Work under a signed project order is billed to that project, not to the monthly fee.
Support outside 08:00-17:00 on weekdays is billed time and materials.
On-site visits are billed time and materials.
Remote support is covered up to 10 hours per calendar month; hours beyond that are billed time and materials.
Patching, monitoring, backup checks and user administration are covered by the monthly fee.
Support for line-of-business applications is outside the managed scope and billed time and materials.

tickets.title: Phone in the lake, Authenticator gone
Printer queue stuck at front desk
Practice software cannot reach server, clinic open Saturday
Imaging software reports a licence error
Question about moving to a new phone system

entries.note: Reset MFA for the hygienist because her phone was lost and she could not approve sign-in prompts. Confirmed she can sign in on the new phone.
Reset MFA for the practice manager after the old phone was wiped and the authenticator did not transfer. Registered the new iPhone and the user confirmed sign-in works.
Cleared the stuck print queue and restarted the spooler on the front-desk PC because jobs had been failing since morning. Test page printed, user confirmed.
Reinstalled the printer driver and removed the duplicate printer object because the queue jammed again. Printed five test pages without errors.
Updated the firmware on the printer since the vendor advisory listed the jam as a known fault. Printer stable after two days, ticket closed.
Installed October cumulative updates on four workstations as scheduled. All rebooted cleanly and reported as compliant.
Replaced the failed SSD in the operatory 2 workstation because it would not boot. Restored the image and the clinician confirmed the imaging software opens.
Restarted the practice software service on the server because clinic was open Saturday and workstations could not connect. Workstations connected again.
Imaged and enrolled the new front-desk PC for unit 3 as part of the refresh, and migrated the user profile. Unit handed over and the user confirmed her shared drives open.
Reviewed the new phone system proposal and compared call-flow options for the practice because the manager asked about moving next quarter. Sent options to the manager; waiting on her choice.
Reviewed the failed backup alert and found the job had failed because the NAS was full. Cleared old restore points and reran the job; it completed.
